⚠️ In two weeks, the prison doors open wider.

From 1 October, offenders currently serving 40% or 50% of their sentence will be released after serving a third. The Victims' Commissioner — the official appointed by government to speak for victims of crime — has said plainly that she does not have confidence these releases can be managed in a way that safeguards victims and protects the public.

She asked for a delay. She got one. She says the safeguards she was promised still haven't been delivered. And it's going ahead regardless. 👇
